comment: The toolchains of php-serialization that no other file declares. npm is declared in the devEngines.packageManager of package.json and PHP in .php-version. mise is the release that make install-tools TOOLS=npm installs with the sha256 of each platform; mise.toml declares the tools it installs and mise.lock locks them. llvm is the major release of LLVM whose libclang and clang the bindgen of ext-php-rs uses in make release-php-ext, which no recipe installs: the ubuntu-26.04 images hold it at /usr/lib/llvm-<major>, the default LLVM_ROOT of packages/release.mk, and the macOS job php of .github/workflows/assets.yml installs it with install-llvm-action and passes its LLVM_PATH as LLVM_ROOT (binding GN-19d, GN-19h, GN-19i). phpExtension.minors are the PHP minors for which the release builds the PHP extension on each platform (.github/workflows/assets.yml, which make workflows-test compares with them).
